name: IBM Security Verify
description: Connect your own IBM Security Verify SaaS tenant to manage Users and Groups (SCIM 2.0), Applications, Access Policies, MFA factors, and review Audit Events for security visibility.

tools.name: connect_verify
tools.description: Connect your own IBM Security Verify SaaS tenant via an API Client (OAuth2 client credentials), after verifying connectivity.

label.description: Friendly tenant label, e.g. 'Acme Corp Verify'.
label.title: Label

client_id.description: API Client's Client ID, from Applications > On-Premises/API clients.
client_id.title: Client Id

tools.name: disconnect_verify
tools.description: Disconnect an IBM Security Verify tenant: deletes only the saved credentials. Nothing in Verify itself is changed.

connection_id.description: Saved IBM Security Verify tenant connection ID to remove from Imperal.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the connected IBM Security Verify tenants.

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List users in the connected IBM Security Verify tenant, optionally filtered by a SCIM filter string.

connection_id.description: Optional saved IBM Security Verify tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

q.description: Optional SCIM filter fragment, e.g. 'userName sw "jane"'.
q.title: Q

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Read one IBM Security Verify user in full by SCIM id.

connection_id.description: Optional saved IBM Security Verify tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

user_id.description: IBM Security Verify SCIM user id.
user_id.title: User Id

tools.name: create_user
tools.description: Create a new IBM Security Verify user via SCIM.

connection_id.description: Optional saved IBM Security Verify tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: update_user
tools.description: Update selected fields of an existing IBM Security Verify user (active state and/or name). Only given fields change.

connection_id.description: Optional saved IBM Security Verify tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

user_id.description: IBM Security Verify SCIM user id.
user_id.title: User Id

active.description: Set true to enable, false to disable sign-in. Omit to leave unchanged.
active.title: Active

given_name.description: New first name, or leave blank to keep unchanged.
given_name.title: Given Name

family_name.description: New last name, or leave blank to keep unchanged.
family_name.title: Family Name

tools.name: delete_user
tools.description: Permanently delete an IBM Security Verify user via SCIM. Cannot be undone -- unlike Okta's deactivate, this is a hard delete.

connection_id.description: Optional saved IBM Security Verify tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

user_id.description: IBM Security Verify SCIM user id.
user_id.title: User Id

tools.name: list_groups
tools.description: List groups in the connected IBM Security Verify tenant.

connection_id.description: Optional saved IBM Security Verify tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

q.description: Optional SCIM filter fragment, e.g. 'displayName sw "Eng"'.
q.title: Q

tools.name: get_group
tools.description: Read one IBM Security Verify group in full.

connection_id.description: Optional saved IBM Security Verify tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

group_id.description: IBM Security Verify SCIM group id.

tools.description: Add a user to an IBM Security Verify group.

connection_id.description: Optional saved IBM Security Verify tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

group_id.description: IBM Security Verify SCIM group id.
group_id.title: Group Id

user_id.description: IBM Security Verify SCIM user id to add/remove.

group_id.description: IBM Security Verify SCIM group id.

user_id.description: IBM Security Verify SCIM user id to add/remove.

tools.name: audit_tenant
tools.description: Build one aggregated health report for the connected IBM Security Verify tenant: total/disabled user counts, group/application counts, and recent failed logins.

connection_id.title: Connection Id

secrets.name: verify_connections
secrets.description: JSON list of connected IBM Security Verify tenants and encrypted API client credentials. Managed only through connect_verify and disconnect_verify.
